_comment: Built-in debug adapters (DAP). An adapter only starts when its command is found (same search path as language servers). transport: 'stdio' = the adapter speaks DAP on stdin/stdout; 'tcp-listen' = the adapter prints 'listening at: host:port' and the editor connects. In 'launch', ${file}, ${dir} (the file's directory) and ${root} (the project root) are replaced. 'experimental' adapters are listed but never chosen automatically.

adapters.name: GHP pages (ghp debug)
adapters.install: hook for the future `ghp debug` adapter
